queries=[
    'Cancel Meeting',
    'Skip this time',
    'Cannot make it',
    "can't make it",
    'will miss',
    'conflict'
]

all_threads=[]
thread_by_id={}
for q in queries:
    page_index=0
    while True:
        page=apis.gmail.show_inbox_threads(access_token=gmail_token, query=q, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
        print('gmail query',repr(q),'page',page_index,'len',len(page))
        if not page:
            break
        for t in page:
            thread_by_id[t['email_thread_id']]=t
        page_index+=1

threads=list(thread_by_id.values())
print('unique threads from queries',len(threads))
# filter by keywords in subject+preview

def cancellation_indicator(t):
    subj=(t.get('subject') or '').lower()
    prev=(t.get('preview') or '').lower()
    text=subj+' '+prev
    # cancellation-like cues
    cues=['cancel','canceled','cancelled','cannot make it','can\'t make it','conflict','will miss','miss the','sorry']
    return any(c in text for c in cues) and ('meeting' in text or 'meet' in text or 'this week' in text)

cands=[t for t in threads if cancellation_indicator(t)]
print('cancellation candidate threads',len(cands))
# show some
cands_sorted=sorted(cands, key=lambda x:x.get('updated_at',''), reverse=True)
for t in cands_sorted[:20]:
    print(t['email_thread_id'], t.get('subject'), 'preview:', (t.get('preview') or '')[:80])
